section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Income tax for the self-employed
value: Business profit is taxed with the same state, municipal and church taxes as salary; income tax and AM-bidrag are paid as B-tax in ten monthly instalments
note: AM-bidrag is charged on business profit as on salary. Under the business tax scheme the provisional 22% is credited when the profit is later taken out and taxed as personal income.
